reviews.title: Absolutely perfect. Worth every penny.
reviews.comment:
The Logitech G PRO X Wireless is hands down the best headset I’ve ever owned. The sound quality is incredible; crisp highs, deep bass, and amazing clarity whether I’m gaming, listening to music, or chatting with friends. The comfort level is top-tier; I can wear it for hours with no pressure or discomfort.
The wireless connection is flawless with zero lag, and the battery life easily lasts through long sessions. The microphone is crystal clear, and the overall build quality feels premium and sturdy.
I have zero complaints, this headset delivers everything I hoped for and more. If you’re on the fence, just buy it. You won’t regret it!
reviews.author: Jessica Pendley

reviews.title: Great headset
reviews.comment: Bought this to replace my astro a50s that had mic issues and am honestly impressed with this headset. The sound quality is great its fits comfortably and the mic is of good quality. I bought it renewed and it looks brand new zero flaws. Would highly recommend.
reviews.author: Roland Taylor Daniel

reviews.title: Wireless Mic has an internal issue and REFERBISHED?? NOT!
reviews.comment:
I knew better than to purchase RENEWED items having worked in the tech field previously but I needed a headset that could both be wireless and wired and this headset was it, however, I could NOT afford NEW. So I thought I would give it a try.
I get it and unbox it  download the drives and the Logitech G App I test it out wireless, but no one can hear me, but I can hear them. I work through everything I can find in troubleshooting the issue since it did not come with directions on what to download, and how to use this headset.  After 24 hours of trying to get the wireless mic to work, I have determined it is an internal issue. I HAVE GONE THROUGH EVERY POSSIBLE STEP TO MAKE THE MIC WORK WIRELESSLY, but it is fruitless.
It works great wired, but that is not the reason I spent so much money on a headset. If I wanted a wired headset I could spend $50 and get a great Razor product.
I know that REFERBISHED is really a word for returned and re-sold, but I was desperate enough I ignored all the reasons for NOT buying refurbished.  The price is not even close to low enough to be worth purchasing a refurbished product. If it was only $50 I would say, well, at least it wasn't nearly $200!  Shame on me... I'm going to return this and get my money back. I will never again be desperate enough to buy "REFERBISHED" Electronic items.  Don't you be fooled... I was a tech person for years, I knew better and I let me desire to have one get the better of me. DON'T do it!
reviews.author: Linde Fam
